text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ardan, I wish you a very happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you. There's something novel
about
hearing you two say that from up
close like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? But back at the estate, we
would
also—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you would wish me a happy
birthday—from
across that enormous
table, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
True... The table at the estate was pretty
massive.
You could hardly see people's
faces at the other
end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's why this is so nice, being able to
look each
other in the eye while
exchanging well wishes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Heh, then I suppose we'll have to say it
many
more times throughout the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, you two. It looks
like this
will be a birthday to remember.
Hehe.
